Gyro - Class in frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.gyro
Wraps a GyroIO implementation to give the rest of the robot code a single, hardware-agnostic gyro API: it caches the latest GyroIO.GyroIOInputs and exposes typed getters, and logs every field via NinjasLogger on each Gyro.periodic() call.

GyroIO - Interface in frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.gyro
Hardware-agnostic interface for a swerve gyro, following the AdvantageKit-style IO pattern: implementations read the physical (or simulated) sensor and populate a plain GyroIO.GyroIOInputs data object each cycle, so higher-level code (see Gyro) never touches vendor APIs directly.
